description: 津波浸水想定 (南海トラフ巨大地震等) [flood and tsunami] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 宮崎県. 「津波浸水想定（南トラR7）」については、データに誤りのある可能性が認められたため、 一時的にリソースの公開を停止しています。 （2025/10/9 18:00） 「津波浸水想定（南トラR7）」については、確認の結果、誤りはなかったため、リソースの公開を再開しました。 ご不便をおかけしました。 （2025/10/15 17:00）... Coverage: 宮崎県. The portal files it under the publisher 宮崎県. Its tags are 南海トラフ地震, 防災. It offers 2 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2025-11-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
